before:

On the saturated 0.5B addition task both methods sit at 0.99. Paired difference −0.002, p = 0.374. A null at the ceiling cannot separate no effect from no headroom.

G = 8 versus G = 2 on the unsaturated rerun is −0.005, interval crossing both zero and the ±0.02 equivalence margin.
